purpose: P0 original edit_prompt versus fixed P1 structured source/edit/target and retention adaptation, five unchanged original IVEBench tasks
condition_scope: Prompt-conditioned embeddings may change. Require actual reference latent/image descriptors and initial AV noise equality to original R54 per-case after generation.
source_event_annotations: No manually selected events. Full 90 input frames; score each source valid prefix and remove fixed spatial padding.
cost: record20NFE/20callbacks/1000blocks/0routes; intermediate20 snapshot time and21files; final capture inside total wall

evaluation.official: Pinned IVEBench Motion Fidelity on original valid physical prefix after fixed16/8 padding crop
evaluation.adaptation: 90-frame H3 canvas; actual per-task source index mapping in original input provenance

acceleration_axes.weights: Same four checkpoint SHAs and nine core SHAs as prior H3 experiments
acceleration_axes.attention: Native PyTorch SDPA via inherited audited block wrapper; H3 Sage patch absent
acceleration_axes.linear_backend: Triton INT8 with inherited row chunking guard
acceleration_axes.sampler: Euler20 manual shifted video sigmas12/audio3, CFG1
acceleration_axes.cache: default Comfy model/node cache across five sequential jobs
acceleration_axes.postprocessing: Original source-to-24FPS index map retained; pad to90; score valid prefix after fixed16px horizontal/8px vertical crop
acceleration_axes.snapshot_cost: 20 intermediate AV snapshots plus final per job; measure separately

prompt_adaptation.bundled_change: reference tagging, source/target information, generic retention rules, structure

initial_AV_noise_equality: PENDING actual P1 inference; fixed seed alone does not prove tensor equality
